reason: I already learn from free YouTube and TikTok clips, and my mum sends me recipes on LINE whenever I ask, so paying every month for recipes doesn't make sense for me. The two free dishes are basil pork with egg and pork omelet, which I can already cook, so the free part shows me nothing new.
objection: Only two free dishes, and I already know how to make both, so I would run out after two dinners. Even 12 more dishes plus one a week is small next to YouTube, where I can find a hundred green curry videos for free.
would_change_my_mind: If the free part had one dish I can't already make, like green curry from paste, so I could see the chef actually do better than a YouTube video before I sign up for anything.
